استدعوا (form X)
# اِسْتَدْعَوْا (istadʕaw) /is.tad.ʕaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# اُسْتُدْعُوا (ustudʕū) /us.tud.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# اِسْتَدْعُوا (istadʕū) /is.tad.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
